positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Stream Processing Platform Team
• Technologies worked with: Java, Spring Boot, React JS, Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins, Terraform, Flink, Artifactory, Maven, Wavefront, Micrometer, Groovy, Python, ArgoCD

positions.title: Machine Learning Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Tutored for Machine Learning (CS 305)
• Taught Machine Learning fundamentals and concepts to roughly 20 students
• Analyzed and debugged Python code of roughly 20 students

positions.title: App Developer
positions.description:
• Intern on the Snap N’ Go team for the CrowdNets Lab developing a crowdsensing/crowdsourcing Slack application
• Refactored legacy code and added task generation/allocation, user reliability calculation, and a recommender system to streamline process, improving workflow and user experience

positions.title: Cybersecurity & Privacy Intern
positions.description:
• Intern on the Implementation & Operations team developing identity access and management
tools
• Improved accuracy of client’s IAM tools, reducing discrepancies in 10+ years of user records
using Java and SailPoint
• Automated generation of financial reports for all client projects using UiPath, optimizing speed
by 50 percent
• Developed PwC’s first privacy chat bot using Python, Flask, Bootstrap, and HTML

positions.title: Data Structures Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Tutored concepts in data structures in Java to roughly 60 intermediate programmers.
• Analyzed, debugged, and graded code written in Java by many different individuals and provided feedback.

positions.title: Introduction to Computer Programming and Problem Solving Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Tutored beginning programming language concepts in Python to roughly 120 beginning programmers.
• Analyzed and graded code written in Python by many different individuals and provided feedback.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
• Developed cross-filtering functionalities that filtered 1000+ data points in less than 3 seconds into over 15 metrics using jQuery and JavaScript.
• Prototyped new metrics to represent information credibility of a story on Twitter to reduce algorithm aversion.
• Redesigned and improved the interactive data visualizations on Twitter Trails (viewable at http://twittertrails.wellesley.edu/~trails/stories/) using D3.js, JavaScript, HTML/CSS.
• Intern at the Human-Computer Interaction Lab.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Intern on the Personal Robotics Group developing a multimodal data storage and
synchronization application that visualizes different modalities
• Built an interactive and multifunctional data analytics tool using Python and Plotly that cross
filtered 5000+ data points to surface meaningful data for researchers

positions.title: User Experience Designer
positions.description:
• Intern on the Dermitas team
• Designed website prototypes, created user stories and performed competitive analysis and research.

positions.title: Cybersecurity Research Assistant
positions.description: • Researched ways to improve cybersecurity in the healthcare industry and drafted a 20-page paper illustrating security inefficiencies in the medical field along with potential solutions.

positions.title: PEEK Weekend Participant and Ambassador
positions.description: • Selected to attend PEEK Weekend at Harvard Business School in which participants get to take their famous case study method classes. This program takes place from June 8, 2018 to June 10, 2018

positions.title: Economics Research Assistant
positions.description: • Investigated intertemporal elasticity of substitution (IES) in global economies and created a database of over 150 articles measuring levels of risk aversion and IES.

positions.title: Boston Symposium Participant
positions.description: • One of the 100 students in the state of Massachusetts selected to attend Goldman Sachs' Boston Symposium series where students were given the opportunity to learn how to make a pitch, interact with professionals at Goldman Sachs, and learn more about the company's culture, values, and goals.
